optimized_sql:
WITH matched_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc AS i_item_desc,
        s.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name AS s_store_name,
        MAX(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
        MAX(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss
    FROM store_returns AS sr
    JOIN store_sales AS ss
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
        AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN date_dim AS d1
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d2
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN store AS s
        ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    JOIN item AS i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE d1.d_moy = 4
        AND d1.d_year = 1999
        AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
        AND d2.d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name
),
cs_agg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    JOIN date_dim AS d3
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    JOIN matched_returns AS mr
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = mr.customer_sk
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = mr.item_sk
    WHERE d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
        AND d3.d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT
    mr.i_item_id,
    mr.i_item_desc,
    mr.s_store_id,
    mr.s_store_name,
    MAX(mr.store_sales_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    MAX(mr.store_returns_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
    MAX(cs_agg.catalog_sales_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM matched_returns AS mr
JOIN cs_agg
    ON mr.customer_sk = cs_agg.customer_sk
    AND mr.item_sk = cs_agg.item_sk
GROUP BY
    mr.i_item_id,
    mr.i_item_desc,
    mr.s_store_id,
    mr.s_store_name
ORDER BY
    mr.i_item_id,
    mr.i_item_desc,
    mr.s_store_id,
    mr.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
